summary_en: VITAL introduces a cascaded registration framework for fast optical-resolution photoacoustic microscopy that explicitly separates geometric alignment from preservation of measured photoacoustic amplitudes. It combines SuperPoint/LightGlue-based global alignment, thin-plate-spline warping, and topology-preserving dense refinement, reporting sub-pixel alignment while retaining 97.83% amplitude-distribution fidelity.

summary_en: This study quantifies how repeated laser pulses can bias oxygen-saturation measurements in fast functional photoacoustic microscopy through transient thermal accumulation. It derives a practical maximum-fluence law, validates it in blood phantoms and the mouse brain, and provides acquisition guidance for accurate high-speed functional imaging.

summary_en: The paper presents an optically interrogated diffraction-grating-coupled Fabry-Pérot ultrasound detector designed for photoacoustic and ultrasonic imaging. The resonator combines normal-incidence interrogation, scalable planar fabrication, bandwidths exceeding 130 MHz, and a tunable responsivity-bandwidth trade-off, with demonstration in an OR-PAM configuration.
